Projection fit ONCE on the pooled union across steps — 24% of variance in 2 components, so the cloud is a weak picture and carries no inference.
× = GAP-no-region (step produced nothing, never interpolated) · ‡ = INSUFFICIENT (region exists, below the pre-declared floor)
